title: Sort Features By Popularity
statement:
Given distinct feature names and user responses, sort the features by how many responses mention them. A feature counts at most once per response. Preserve the original feature order when counts tie.

## Examples

```text
Input: features = ["cooler", "lock", "touch"], responses = ["i like cooler cooler", "lock touch cool", "lock cooler"]
Output: ["cooler", "lock", "touch"]
```

```text
Input: features = ["a", "aa", "b", "c"], responses = ["a", "a aa", "a a a a a", "b a"]
Output: ["a", "aa", "b", "c"]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= features.length <= 10^4`; feature names are distinct lowercase words of length at most 10.
- `1 <= responses.length <= 100`
- Each response is 1 to 1000 lowercase letters and single spaces, without leading or trailing spaces.
